Person: What year did the Berlin Wall fall? It's for my son's school poster.
AI: 1989.
Person: Thanks! Printing 30 copies now.
answer: Just to be sure before those print: yes, 1989 is right. The crossings opened on the night of 9 November 1989, after East German official Günter Schabowski announced new travel rules at a press conference and crowds gathered at the checkpoints until the guards let them through. The physical demolition carried on into 1990, and Germany reunified on 3 October 1990, but the fall of the Wall is dated to 9 November 1989. So the poster is fine. Good luck to your son!
